description: Listed Building Consent (Part Retrospective): internal and external alterations including signage, shelving, sinks, stainless steel wall protection, and removal of wall
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>
